notes: Crash-loop safe mode: a launcher 'Safe mode' shortcut and dshmobile://safe-mode open a minimal recovery screen that skips the normal app shell - Start normally, Clear caches only, Reset appearance/notification settings, Share crash log, or open Android App info. A crash recorder (3 crashes in 10 min, synchronous write, idempotent handlers) routes crash-looping launches into safe mode before AppState/Compose; a normal run clears the counter after 60s. Host pairing, drafts, queued prompts and app lock are always preserved. Also includes Tailscale one-tap sign-in and recovery links in 0.2.112.
